## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## User or operator impact

Describe visible behavior, configuration, API, security, or migration effects. Write “None” when there are none.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run lint`

## Safety

- [ ] No tokens, private repository metadata, customer information, or generated dependency/build files are included.
- [ ] Activity labels remain distinct from build, deployment, security, and uptime health.
